setlist.title: It Must Have Been The Roses

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Estimated Prophet** (3 reviews): The Estimated into Eyes of the World pairing is rated good, as it nearly always is; Features jaw-dropping playing from Garcia and Weir fanning [13][17][18]
- **Shakedown Street** (2 reviews): The whole crowd stomped along to the second-set opener; Garcia's guitar drops out, but the groove stays epic regardless [15][18]
- **Day Job** (2 reviews): The Day Job encore lets down an otherwise good second set; Reviewer toured in the mid-eighties but never saw this Day Job, and found hearing it fresh moving [13][14]
- **Walking The Dog** (1 review): Reviewer calls this a rare opener [15]
- **Might As Well** (1 review): Garcia's voice is out of shape on this song, though fine for the rest of the show [13]

## Setlist highlights

- **Walking The Dog**: back after 152 archived shows (869 days); rare: 9 archived performances [24]

## The recordings

- **gd1984-03-29.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.32515.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 18 songs; 145 min; rated 4.5/5 by 4 [1]. Said about its sound: Charlie Miller's transfer has good sound quality [16]
- **gd1984-03-29.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.106071.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 147 min; rated 2/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd1984-03-29.177918.schoeps.mk4.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 18 songs; 149 min [3]
- **gd1984-03-29.176072.neumann.km84i.bradt.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 18 songs; 146 min [5]
- **gd1984-03-29.3micSonyTCD5M.D5scott.109112.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 146 min; rated 4.5/5 by 4 [7]. Said about its sound: Audience source presents Phil's playing clearly and Garcia's guitar more consistently than the soundboard does [20]
- **gd1984-03-29.sonyecm.andrewf.29645.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 17 songs; 148 min [8]. Said about its sound: Taper sat near a whistling audience member; the whistle was softened in editing, less jarring than on the master [8]

## Around the show

- Attendee sat about three rows back, in a small hall of roughly 1500, with a low stage and no barrier [15]
- Part of the first Rex Foundation benefit shows at Marin Civic; the band was rested and at home [17]
- Reviewer was backstage with friends during Space and recalls it vividly [19]
- Surround-sound ambient speakers were used at these shows, mostly audible on Eyes vocals and in drums and space [8]
- Reviewer asks whether this matches the 28th, and says a 20th-row audience recording sounds better than these soundboards [12]
- Reviewer says better 1984 shows include 7-22 and the Berkeley run of late October and early November [16]
- Reviewer calls the whole run inspired work, perhaps a last high point before a weaker period [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1984-03-29.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.32515.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette (Maxell XLIIS-90) [1]
- **gd1984-03-29.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.106071.flac16**: taped by Paul Scotton and Joani Walker; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony D5) -> Cassette (Sony D5/Maxell XLIIS-90) [2]. Also: Tapes came from Joani Walker and Paul Scotton; Joe B. Jones helped with pitch correction [2]
- **gd1984-03-29.177918.schoeps.mk4.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Scott Wiseman; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Scott Wiseman's Master Audience Cassettes; Schoeps MK4 mics > Sony TC-D5M (Maxell UDXLII 90) [3]
- **gd1984-03-29.176072.neumann.km84i.bradt.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Bill Bradt; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Bill Bradt's Master Audience Cassettes: Neumann KM84i mics > Sony D5M (Maxell UDXL-IIS) [5]. Also: A 24-second patch in Drums comes from an AKG d330bt and Sennheiser 421 blend source [5]
- **gd1984-03-29.3micSonyTCD5M.D5scott.109112.flac16**: taped by "Da Weez"; transferred by D5scott; source: 2 Beyer M160 & 1 Sennheiser 421 Microphones > Nak MX100 w/2001 > Sony TC-D5M - analog master cassettes - TDK MA-R90's [7]
- **gd1984-03-29.sonyecm.andrewf.29645.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Andrew F.; transferred by Andrew F.; source: Sony ECM-939LT stereo mics (x2) > Marantz PMD-340 cassette deck > TDX AD-X tape (Dolby on) [8]. Also: A tape flip during Drums, at 7:51, loses only a few seconds [8]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Steven Rood Grateful Dead: [1984-04-01 Marin County Veterans Auditorium, San Rafael, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1984-04-01-marin-county-veterans-auditorium-san-rafael-ca-usa/) [25]
